pages.text: $(l)Where$(/l)$(br2)Press K, click $(l)Barter$(/l) on the left, then pick $(l)Exchange Mode$(/l) to see bounties posted by others.

$(l)How to read it$(/l)$(br2)- $(l)arrows$(/l) flip to the prev/next bounty$(br2)- format: $(l)name gives: xxx / wants: yyy$(/l)$(br2)$(br2)Items show their $(l)in-game names$(/l) (not internal ids); big amounts are shortened to things like "12K" / "100M".

$(l)How to accept$(/l)$(br2)Click $(l)Accept$(/l) and the mod swaps automatically:$(br2)- you receive their $(l)I give$(/l)$(br2)- they receive your $(l)I want$(/l) (into their mailbox)$(br2)$(br2)If either side lacks the items, the trade is $(l)cancelled and rolled back$(/l) - nothing is swallowed.
